docView.empty_design: No design yet. Once you approve the requirements in the conversation, the technical design lands here.
docView.empty_requirements: No requirements written yet — describe what you want in the conversation and the agent will draft this document.
docView.empty_tasks: No task list yet. After you approve the design, the ordered task list lands here.
docView.your_feedback_on_the_passage_in: Your feedback on the selected passage in {{document}}
docView.your_feedback_on_this_passage_enter_adds: Your feedback on this passage… (Enter adds it to the stack)

newSpecView.describe_what_you_want_to_do: Describe what you want to do
newSpecView.e_g_add_login_with_google_so_users_don_t: e.g. “Add login with Google so users don’t need passwords” or “The export button crashes on large files”
newSpecView.fresh_worktree_option_pick_a_project_fol: Fresh-worktree option: pick a project folder above — if it’s a git repository, I can plan and build in a dedicated worktree so your main checkout stays untouched.
newSpecView.keeps_your_main_checkout_untouched_branc: Keeps your main checkout untouched: I'll create a branch {{branch}} in its own folder next to the repo, and plan + build there.
newSpecView.tell_me_what_you_have_in_mind_i_ll_ask_a:
Tell me what you have in mind. I’ll ask a few clarifying questions in chat, write up a plan you can review, and
          then build it when you’re ready.
newSpecView.this_folder_isn_t_a_git_repository_so_i_: This folder isn’t a git repository, so I’ll work in it directly. Pick a git repo to get the option of a fresh worktree (keeps your main checkout untouched).
newSpecView.type_bug_blurb: Investigate the problem, find the root cause, and plan the fix.
newSpecView.type_feature_blurb: A full plan: requirements, technical design, and a task list.
newSpecView.type_quick_blurb: Skip the formality — just a goal and a task list.
newSpecView.what_do_you_want_to_do: What do you want to do?
newSpecView.what_kind_of_work_is_it: What kind of work is it?
newSpecView.your_plan_is_saved_as_plain_markdown_ins: Your plan is saved as plain markdown inside your project (.kiro/specs), so it also works with the Kiro IDE and CLI. You can change where specs are stored in

projectPicker.no_subfolders_here_use_use_this_folder_a: No subfolders here — use “Use this folder” above to pick this one.
projectPicker.load_failed_unknown: The read failed without a reason.

settingsModal.couldn_t_load_these_settings: Couldn’t load these settings, so saving is off until they load.
settingsModal.default_keeps_the_model_your_chat_agent_: Default keeps whatever model your chat agent already resolves to. A pick applies to spec sessions that start after the change — a spec already in progress keeps its current model.
settingsModal.empty_keep_specs_with_each_project_recom: Empty = keep specs with each project (recommended)
settingsModal.leave_this_empty_to_keep_specs_inside_ea:
Leave this empty to keep specs inside each project (a .kiro/specs folder next to your code — the Kiro standard).
        Or set a folder path to collect all specs in one place instead.
settingsModal.which_model_should_run_spec_generation: Which model should run spec generation?

specDetail.an_agent_will_work_through_the_task_list: An agent will work through the task list
specDetail.couldn_t_remove_this_spec_try_again: Couldn’t remove this spec — try again.
specDetail.remove_spec_body: “{{name}}” will leave Spec Builder. The markdown files stay in the project, and any running agent for this spec will be stopped.
specDetail.rename_this_spec_label_the_folder_name_s: Rename this spec’s label. Its folder and branch name stay the same.
specDetail.tells_the_agent_this_phase_is_approved_a: Records your approval of this version, then tells the agent to move on
specDetail.the_agent_is_writing_the_next_document: Approved — the agent is writing the next document
specDetail.this_document_changed_after_it_was_appro: This document changed after it was approved

taskList.no_tasks_yet: No tasks yet. Once the design is approved, the ordered task list lands here and you can run tasks one at a time.
taskList.pause_the_build_first: Pause the build before running a single task
taskList.run_only_this_task_and_stop: Run only this task, then stop

workspace.describe_what_you_want_to_build_answer_a: Describe what you want to build, answer a few questions, and get a reviewed plan — requirements, design, and tasks — that an agent can execute for you.
workspace.pick_a_spec_to_continue_where_you_left_o: Pick a spec to continue where you left off
workspace.plan_your_next_feature_with_a_spec: Plan your next feature with a spec

manifest.description: Spec-driven development inside Kiro Crew: turn a feature idea into Requirements → Design → Tasks with an embedded agent, review the markdown in-app, then hand the approved plan off to an autonomous execution session.
manifest.use_case_1: Turn a feature, bug, or quick task into reviewable repository-aware requirements, design, and implementation steps.
manifest.configuration_1: Choose a project folder and Feature, Bug, or Quick mode, optionally create a fresh worktree, then review and approve each generated stage before starting the build.

specBuilderPage.talk_through_an_idea_review_the_plan_the: Talk through an idea, review the plan, then let an agent build it.
